run_model_free_ptq_fp8_block: run model_free_ptq to apply FP8-Block quantization to Qwen3-0.6B model
run_model_free_ptq_with_ignore: run model_free_ptq with ignore list to skip embed_tokens and lm_head layers
run_model_free_ptq_custom_device: run model_free_ptq with custom device and max_workers for GPU parallel quantization
run_model_free_ptq_save_directory: run model_free_ptq to quantize and save compressed-tensors output to a specified directory
run_model_free_ptq_scheme: run model_free_ptq with FP8_BLOCK scheme for post-training quantization
